notes.title: If you can read this, you are a beautiful human ♥ ღゝ◡╹ )ノ♡
notes.content:
★~(◡ω◡✿) Recently,

We have had overwhelming support for this game, even if it is meant as satire.. We thank everyone that owns this game from the bottom of our hearts. ~ you are a ★ in this universe. We know drowning can be a bore, but we appreciate you are not a sore!

We are currently updating the game with new easter-eggs, fish and even guns o.o

We also wanted to bring cool looking game artwork to your profile, but to get there we need your [b]support[/b]. (๑´• .̫ •ू`๑) We want to have cool achievements, badges, backgrounds and more for you to showoff! (⁄ ⁄>⁄ ▽ ⁄<⁄ ⁄)  Steam limits that ability for small studios..

Therefore:
★~ If you review this game, we will send you steam points!
★~ If you buy it for a friend you also help us achieve our goal, and get your friend a dope game! :3
★~The top community Achievements, Backgrounds or whatever will be in the game and available on your profile, do you want your avatar as an achievement? Now you can! But we need your support

★~ The first people to step up will be honored forever within the game. ★~

_______________________

You are amazing.
